prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universal “best” interior painting company in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your budget, schedule, the size and condition of the job, and whether you want extras like color consulting or specialty finishes. I can help you find the best fit. Below are practical steps, what to look for, and a quick checklist to use when comparing painters.

How to find the best interior painter for you
- Use local review sites: check Google Maps, Yelp, Angi (HomeAdvisor), Houzz and the BBB. Look for companies with many recent 4–5 star reviews and before/after photos.
- Prefer teams that are licensed, insured (general liability + workers’ comp), and willing to provide a written contract and references.
- Look at portfolios for work similar to yours (historic home? condo? high ceilings? textured walls?).
- Ask about prep work included (patching, sanding, priming), number of coats, paint brand/quality, cleanup, and warranty/guarantee.
- Get at least 3 written estimates that break down labor, materials, and prep.
- Ask for a small test patch or sample coat on a wall before committing to the whole job.

Questions to ask every painter
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you show insurance certificates?
- Do you have local references I can contact? Can I see before/after photos?
- What paint brands and sheen levels will you use? How many coats?
- What prep work is included? Will you move furniture and cover floors?
- What is the projected timeline and start date? Who will supervise the job?
- Do you provide a written estimate and warranty? What does the warranty cover?

Ballpark pricing (approximate)
- Per room: commonly $300–$800 for a standard bedroom, depending on size and prep.
- Per square foot: expect roughly $1.50–$4.00/sq ft total (varies by region, quality of paint, and complexity).
- Higher for vaulted ceilings, lots of patching, trim/cabinet painting, or specialty finishes.

Next step I can do for you
- If you want, tell me your ZIP code, whether this is a whole-house or a single-room job, any special requirements (color consult, trim/cabinet work, high ceilings), and your budget/timeline. I’ll give a short list of top-rated providers in your area and a recommended shortlist of questions to ask them — or I can draft a message/email you can send to painters to get comparable estimates.

Would you like me to search for top-rated painters in your neighborhood (share your ZIP) or help draft an email/script to contact painters?
